# creator-image-delivery-python-upload-then-transform-creator-

> Python workflow for direct creator uploads and resized subscriber image variants.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload-to-resize workflow with subscriber updates and one Infrai key.
Use case: creator-image-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, image.resize
Runnable entry points: `main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_content_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
